title: Validation report
description: Immutable derived result of validating pinned artifact revisions (and optionally derived documents) against one validation profile (design decision ADR-016). 'result' is 'pass' if and only if 'status' = 'completed' and no finding has severity 'error' or 'critical'. A report alone never authorizes an action; gate evaluations decide. Identical pinned inputs yield identical reports apart from the members excluded from 'resultDigest'.

documentType.description: Document type discriminator of a validation report.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

createdAt.description: UTC time the report was produced. Excluded from 'resultDigest'.

targetRefs.description: Pinned artifact revisions the report is about, sorted by artifactId, revisionId.

derivedSubjectRefs.description: Derived documents checked by the report (such as evaluations, snapshots, scenes and print jobs), sorted by id, digest. Omitted when there are none.

inputDigests.description: Digests of the pinned inputs of the validation.

status.description: 'completed' if the validation ran to the end, 'failed' if it could not be completed.

result.description: 'pass' if and only if 'status' = 'completed' and no finding has severity 'error' or 'critical'; otherwise 'fail'.

findings.description: Findings in finding order (see the finding fragment).

resultDigest.description: Digest of this document excluding 'contentDigest', 'resultDigest', 'reportId' and every top-level member ending in 'At' (digest profile d2p-digest-v1).

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this whole document in canonical form, excluding 'contentDigest' itself.

extensions.description: Optional extension blocks keyed by extension namespace.
